title: Constant unary output
statement: For every natural number $C$ and Boolean word $s$, the machine that emits the fixed prefix of $C$ ones, started on the empty input in its initial state with empty output and its single work tape containing ones at cells $0$ through $|s|$ and blanks elsewhere, reaches after $C+1$ steps a halted configuration whose output is the word of $C$ ones; the work tape and its head position are unchanged.
replaced:
The fixed-prefix emitter for the word $1^C$, started on the empty virtual
input in the bank for candidate $s$ (it has no scratch tapes), halts after
exactly $C+1$ steps with captured output $1^C$, the final step being the
blank-reading halt.
